Version 0.1.1 of nox-influencer-marketing

- Updated setup instructions: registration and API key links for both English and Chinese users are now provided explicitly when CLI is missing.

- Now supports paginated creator search ("show more", "next page", "继续"), with correct handling for cursor-based pagination and end-of-results messaging.

Initial release of the NoxInfluencer marketing skill—enables full creator discovery, evaluation, contact, and monitoring via the NoxInfluencer CLI.

- Supports creator search, detailed analysis, contact info retrieval, and campaign tracking across YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram.
- Guides users through account setup, quota checks, and error handling, surfacing only actionable next steps.
- Presents search results as easy-to-read shortlists, with contextual next actions.
- Summarizes creator analysis with verdicts and supporting evidence—avoids information overload.
- Does not draft outreach content, send emails, or manage campaign budgets directly.
